@Sofia, the number you want is **10%**. Bettina first posted 12% in #coastal-team on Nov 17, 2025 at 14:19, then corrected it to 10% at 14:24, saying she had misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark. Nothing in the channel contradicts the 10%, and the Coastal cheat sheet says any discount over 10% needs Anselm's approval, which fits.

I couldn't see the signed order form or amendment for Saltmarsh, so I can't confirm 10% against the contract itself. Before the renewal brief goes out, it's worth asking June Osei-Lark to confirm it against the deal desk record.
